svg.title: Azure Infrastructure Landing Zone
svg.desc: A modular, fully automated Azure landing zone in Terraform with 9 reusable modules: VNet, Subnet, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Bastion, Key Vault, VM, Public IP and Resource Group. Pipeline: bootstrap remote state (TLS 1.2, no public blob access), then init, validate and plan with Gitleaks secret scanning, then apply to preprod and prod, which compose the same modules with their own variables.
